decisions.reason: The thermoforming unit is close to the core dental equipment offer, has stayed on its own page for two years, and costs little to carry within the existing portfolio, so the option is still worth holding.

The orthopedic shoe last is distant from the core business and its value is still highly uncertain after one year, but it shows visible commitment with its own page, so keeping the option open another year is justified despite the higher risk.
The post-curing unit fits the firm's digital and 3D-printing workflow and is cheap to keep alongside related equipment, though its mere mention suggests modest emphasis among the firm's many options.
